_comment: Companion to clone-inherited-inv2-inv5-still-fire.json, covering INV 5b specifically. 'DynamicPageHeader' is present by name+type in clone-canonical-source.json, so provenance waives INV 1 for it — but this clone's header width no longer matches its parent's (the layoutSizingHorizontal='FILL' no-op that hid content in the live build). PROVES INV 5b fires on an INHERITED node. Verify with --canonical-dump clone-canonical-source.json. Expected: exit 2 with FAIL_HEADER_WIDTH_MISMATCH.
